# BPM

> BPM is a comprehensive tax, advisory, and accounting firm serving diverse client types and industries with specialized expertise in compliance, wealth management, and growth strategy.

BPM provides integrated tax, audit, and advisory services across multiple client segments—from startups and private companies to public corporations, private equity firms, and high-net-worth individuals. The firm maintains specialized practices in emerging sectors like blockchain and digital assets, as well as traditional industries including real estate, financial services, and life sciences.

## Key Topics

- Tax Advisory & Planning
- Accounting Services
- Compliance & Audit
- Wealth Management
- Family Office Services
- Private Client Services
- Startup Support
- Business Consulting
- Technical Accounting
- Portfolio Management
- SEC Compliance
- Blockchain & Digital Assets
- Growth Strategy
- Legacy Planning
- Industry Solutions

## Core Services

- [Tax, Advisory, and Accounting Firm | BPM](https://www.bpm.com): BPM homepage: trusted tax, advisory, and accounting services for diverse business types.
- [Client Center - BPM](https://www.bpm.com/client-center): Client portal for account management, billing, payments, and partnership resources.

## Client Types & Business Stages

- [Public Company - BPM](https://www.bpm.com/who-we-serve/clients-like-you/public-company): BPM services for public companies: SEC compliance, audit, advisory, and stakeholder reporting.
- [Privately-Held Company - BPM](https://www.bpm.com/who-we-serve/clients-like-you/privately-held-company): BPM services for private companies: succession planning, growth strategy, family businesses.
- [Startup - BPM](https://www.bpm.com/who-we-serve/clients-like-you/startup): BPM startup services: back-office operations, accounting outsourcing, growth-stage support.
- [Private Equity & Venture Capital - BPM](https://www.bpm.com/who-we-serve/clients-like-you/pe-and-vc): BPM PE/VC services: portfolio management, CFO services, transaction support, value creation.
- [Business Stages | BPM](https://www.bpm.com/who-we-serve/business-stages): BPM guidance for companies at different lifecycle stages: startup, scaling, growth, maturity.
